items.description: Somoto is the capital of the Madriz department, known for its proximity to a deep river canyon.
Ocotal serves as the seat of the Nueva Segovia department, located in the mountainous north.
Diriamba is a cultural town in the Carazo department, famous for its traditional dances and coffee production.
Somotillo is a town in the Chinandega department, situated near the border with Honduras.
Sebaco is a major commercial intersection in the Matagalpa department, serving as a hub for regional agriculture.
Posoltega is a municipality in the Chinandega department, historically focused on agriculture.
Masatepe is a town in the Masaya department, recognized for its artisan crafts and furniture making.
Niquinohomo is a historic town in the Masaya department, known as the birthplace of Augusto César Sandino.
Rio Blanco is a growing town in the Matagalpa department, acting as a gateway to the Caribbean region.
Rosita is a mining town in the North Caribbean Coast Autonomous Region, historically significant for mineral extraction.
